audit_items.proof_trace: The delete (L449-453) and insert (L460-461) of member_team_relations are two separate autocommitted Supabase REST calls with no wrapping DB transaction or RPC. If the DELETE commits but the INSERT fails (FK violation, network error, etc.), the catch at L470 returns an error but the deletion is permanent — the member is left with zero team relations. No retry or compensation logic exists.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An admin submits a valid updateMemberAdmin call; the DELETE on member_team_relations commits; a transient error causes the INSERT to fail; the admin sees an error response but the member's team assignments have been silently wiped and are not automatically restored.
